page.overview:
Who is Cucco?

Cuccos, alternatively named Chickens, are recurring Animals in . They first appear in .

Despite appearing as mere chickens, Cuccos are infamously known for aggressively attacking Link in retaliation if he attacks them for an extended period of time, and are sometimes known as the "Cucco's Revenge Squad".

In their first appearance in , Cuccos could be found in Kakariko Village. This game also introduced their vengeful "Revenge Squad" behavior. Cucco-like monsters appear in the Dark World, reacting identically to their Light World counterparts, including the revenge squad attack.

Cuccos in , unlike most other games, cannot be lifted or thrown without the aid of the Power Bracelet, and could mainly be found in Mabe Village. They can be killed using the Magic Powder or Magic Rod. Because of this, is the only title in series which Cuccos can be destroyed by Link. When Cuccos are eliminated by the hero, the revenge squad will disappear and stop attacking. The ability to kill Cuccos is removed in the Switch re-release of the game.
